text: Hey so i was using the map painter, and so here is something im wondering if you might have a solution for, but if i do even a height field of 2 and then i am placing some flora around it, im getting this problem here that i really dont like [Image #26] notice how this side of the hill is bare. well i have tried to drown it in flora and it just stays bare D:
resolution: Fixed the bare-hillside flora bug: regenPaintFoliage sampled terrain height ONCE at each painted cell's centre and planted every blade/flower/bush/palm at that single height, while blades scatter up to half a cell away — on a slope the ground rises past the 0.26-0.55m blade height and swallows them, so drowning the slope in paint changed nothing. Now every foliage row is re-seated on the terrain under its OWN x/z (seatRowOnTerrain in world_loader.zig; palms move trunk+crown by one shared footing delta so bark and fronds stay attached). Needs a dev-host rebuild (Zig change) to see it.
